in_marathi.name: Dheepta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheepta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dheepa’ meaning a ‘deepak’ or lamp. In Hindu mythology, Dheepta is a name of the divine god Vishnu, who illuminates the path for his devotees. It symbolizes enlightenment and knowledge.
